text: Entry Requirements Applicants must hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificates for four years or above and have an actual overseas residential record for at least two years over the last four years (by the end of April 30th of the year of entry). Applicants of Bachelor Degree Programs shall be under the age of 25 and hold a High School Certificate or higher diploma. Applicants of English-medium Programs shall provide TOEFL iBT 80 or above/IELTS 6.0 or above/certificate or English as the instruction language during previous studies.
